Callout.Name: Insecure Load
Callout.Message: Lorry shedding its load on the highway.
Callout.Advisory: Debris across two lanes, driver stopped ahead.

Script.Line: It is shedding off the back every hundred yards.
It is timber and there is a lot of it.
The driver has pulled onto the shoulder and he is looking at it.

Lines.Approach: Two lanes full of it and the driver has pulled up ahead. Somebody is going to hit that.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
